clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Ashenvale, Dal Bloodclaw's Skull marks the end of a threat to Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner receives it as proof that an attack on the night elf settlement has been averted.

The Thistlefur furbolgs north of Astranaar have grown in number and aggression. Like much of Ashenvale's ancient forest, they have been corrupted. Raene Wolfrunner, a night elf sentinel, fears they will soon march on Astranaar. She orders their ranks culled and their leader, Dal Bloodclaw, slain. His skull gives grim proof that the tribe's leadership has been shattered, buying Astranaar's defenders precious time.
